sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zài zhè bù chōng mǎn le ěr yú wǒ zhà bèi xìn qì yì jiàn lì wàng yì de hòu hēi qí shū lǐ Jīng Kē nà dào jué jué bù huí tóu de bèi yǐng bǎo zhù le Zhōng Guó rén de xìn niàn

words.en: that (measure word for light or shadow)

sentences.zh: 他用生命证明了,算计可以决定利益,但算计永远决定不了灵魂的高度,在这个冷酷的世界上,总有一些东西比利益更重要,比权势更重要,甚至比性命还要重要,合上战国策这本厚厚的古籍,两千多年前的刀光剑影与唇枪舌剑渐渐远去,但我们的后背或许还会有一丝凉意,眼眶还会有一丝温热。
sentences.en: He used his life to prove that calculation can determine interests, but calculation can never determine the height of the soul. In this cold world, there are always things more important than interests, more important than power, even more important than life itself. And with the Strategies of the Warring States, this thick ancient book, the sword shadows and verbal battles from over two thousand years ago gradually fade away, but perhaps our backs will still feel a chill, and our eyes a warmth.
sentences.pinyin: tā yòng shēng mìng zhèng míng le suàn jì kě yǐ jué dìng lì yì dàn suàn jì yǒng yuǎn jué dìng bù liǎo líng hún de gāo dù zài zhè ge lěng kù de shì jiè shàng zǒng yǒu yī xiē dōng xī bǐ lì yì gèng zhòng yào bǐ quán shì gèng zhòng yào shèn zhì bǐ xìng mìng hái yào zhòng yào hé shàng Zhànguócè zhè běn hòu hòu de gǔ jí liǎng qiān duō nián qián de dāo guāng jiàn yǐng yǔ chún qiāng shé jiàn jiàn jiàn yuǎn qù dàn wǒ men de hòu bèi huò xǔ hái huì yǒu yī sī liáng yì yǎn kuàng hái huì yǒu yī sī wēn rè

sentences.zh: 我们今天为什么要读战国策,不是为了让你去学那些阴谋鬼。
sentences.en: Why do we read the Strategies of the Warring States today? It is not to teach you to learn those schemers.
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men jīn tiān wèi shén me yào dú Zhànguócè bù shì wèi le ràng nǐ qù xué nà xiē yīn móu guǐ

words.en: Strategies of the Warring States, a collection of political anecdotes and speeches

sentences.zh: 而是为了让你在这个复杂的成人世界里拥有一双看穿表象的眼睛。
sentences.en: Instead, it is to give you a pair of eyes that see through appearances in this complex adult world.
sentences.pinyin: ér shì wèi le ràng nǐ zài zhè ge fù zá de chéng rén shì jiè lǐ yōng yǒu yī shuāng kàn chuān biǎo xiàng de yǎn jīng

sentences.zh: 当你身处人生低谷,遭遇人情冷暖,被人白眼相向的时候,请你想一想洛阳城里那个连嫂子都不给饭吃的苏秦,别抱怨,别崩溃,关起门来打磨自己的硬实力。
sentences.en: When you are in the low points of life, experiencing the warmth and coldness of human relationships, and being looked down upon, please think of Su Qin in Luoyang city who was not even given food by his sister-in-law. Don't complain, don't collapse, close the door and sharpen your own hard skills.
sentences.pinyin: dāng nǐ shēn chǔ rén shēng dī gǔ zāo yù rén qíng lěng nuǎn bèi rén bái yǎn xiāng xiàng de shí hòu qǐng nǐ xiǎng yī xiǎng luò yáng chéng lǐ nà ge lián sǎo zi dōu bù gěi fàn chī de Sū Qín bié bào yuàn bié bēng kuì guān qǐ mén lái dǎ mó zì jǐ de yìng shí lì

words.en: Su Qin, a Warring States diplomat

sentences.zh: 当你手里有了筹码,世界自然会对你和颜悦色。
sentences.en: When you have chips in your hand, the world will naturally treat you kindly.
sentences.pinyin: dāng nǐ shǒu lǐ yǒu le chóu mǎ shì jiè zì rán huì duì nǐ hé yán yuè sè

sentences.zh: 当你在职场或家庭里遇到沟通死局,面对固执的上司或亲人时,请你想一想跛脚的触龙和照镜子的邹忌,收起无效的情绪对抗,学会顺着人性的脉络去拆解问题。
sentences.en: When you encounter communication deadlocks at work or home, facing stubborn bosses or relatives, please think of the lame Chu Long and the mirror-looking Zou Ji. Put away ineffective emotional resistance and learn to unravel problems by following the thread of human nature.
sentences.pinyin: dāng nǐ zài zhí chǎng huò jiā tíng lǐ yù dào gōu tōng sǐ jú miàn duì gù zhí de shàng sī huò qīn rén shí qǐng nǐ xiǎng yī xiǎng bǒ jiǎo de chù lóng hé zhào jìng zi de Zōu Jì shōu qǐ wú xiào de qíng xù duì kàng xué huì shùn zhe rén xìng de mài luò qù chāi jiě wèn tí

words.en: Zou Ji, a minister of the state of Qi

sentences.zh: 当你春风得意,手握资源的时候,请你想一想烧掉债券的冯谖,别把事情做绝,多给别人留条活路,就是给未来的自己留条退路。
sentences.en: When you are proud and hold resources, please think of Feng Xuan who burned bonds. Don't do things to the extreme; leaving others a way out is leaving a retreat path for your future self.
sentences.pinyin: dāng nǐ chūn fēng dé yì shǒu wò zī yuán de shí hòu qǐng nǐ xiǎng yī xiǎng shāo diào zhài quàn de féng xuān bié bǎ shì qíng zuò jué duō gěi bié rén liú tiáo huó lù jiù shì gěi wèi lái de zì jǐ liú tiáo tuì lù

sentences.zh: 而最重要的是在你看透了这世间所有的利益算计,经历了所有的世态炎凉之后,心里依然能留着一点鲁仲连的傲骨,一点荆轲的孤勇,像策士一样清醒地谋事,像侠客一样炽热地做人,唯有手里握着智慧的剑,心里亮着刀,
sentences.en: And most importantly, after seeing through all the calculations of interests in this world and experiencing all the harsh realities, your heart can still hold a bit of Lu Zhonglian's proud spirit and Jing Ke's solitary courage, plan like a strategist with clarity, live like a hero with passion, only by holding the sword of wisdom in your hand and the blade shining in your heart.
sentences.pinyin: ér zuì zhòng yào de shì zài nǐ kàn tòu le zhè shì jiān suǒ yǒu de lì yì suàn jì jīng lì le suǒ yǒu de shì tài yán liáng zhī hòu xīn lǐ yī rán néng liú zhe yī diǎn Lǔ Zhòng lián de ào gǔ yī diǎn Jīng Kē de gū yǒng xiàng cè shì yī yàng qīng xǐng de móu shì xiàng xiá kè yī yàng chì rè de zuò rén wéi yǒu shǒu lǐ wò zhe zhì huì de jiàn xīn lǐ liàng zhe dāo

sentences.zh: 我们才能在这漫长而颠簸的人世间走得既稳当又坦荡。
sentences.en: Only then can we walk steadily and openly through this long and turbulent human world.
